detail.proof_sketch: min over completions of [sum_j s_j f_j + sum_{j<k free} K_jk s_j s_k] >= sum_j min(s_j f_j) + sum_{j<k} min(K_jk s_j s_k) = -sum|f_j| - sum|K_jk|; each term bounded independently so the sum of minima is <= the minimum of the sum.
